feat(conventional-changelog-angular,conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits,template): fail loudly when a preset is rendered by an old writer (#1539)

conventional-changelog-writer@8 and older compile a handlebars mainTemplate
string, which modern presets no longer provide. In a mixed versions install,
e.g. the preset hoisted to the latest major next to tooling that bundles
writer@8, the writer silently fell back to its default template and produced
a changelog with empty sections.

Presets now plant a mainTemplate which throws a self-describing error when
an old writer renders it. Modern writers have no such option and ignore it.

closes #1495

fix(conventional-changelog): add conventional-commits-filter to dependencies (#1536)

ConventionalGitClient#loadDeps() unconditionally imports both
conventional-commits-parser and conventional-commits-filter on the
getCommits() path, but only the parser was declared as a dependency.
The filter was reachable only through git-client's optional peer
dependency, which npm 11 prunes from the install (npm/cli#9249),
causing ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at runtime during changelog generation.

Co-authored-by: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(git-client): end the options list before caller provided values (#1535)

A value starting with a dash was parsed by git as an option, so
`checkout('--pathspec-from-file=/tmp/secret')` made git read that file and
report its lines in the error output, which `exec` turns into the message of
the thrown error. A commits or tags range could reach `git log --output=<file>`
and write the log to an arbitrary path.

`--end-of-options` is used rather than `--`: in `git checkout` the latter means
that pathspecs follow, which is why it was removed in 993c1fdd, and restoring
it would break branch switching again.

fix(conventional-changelog,conventional-changelog-writer,conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits,template): use current host url paths (#1534)

GitLab removed the urls without the `-/` separator in 16.0, so every commit,
issue and comparison link generated for GitLab pointed at a legacy path.

Host configs now carry the comparison path as well, and both presets read the
issue path from the context instead of hardcoding it. Bitbucket issue links
follow along: its config still used the legacy singular `issue` path.

Fixes #986.

feat(conventional-changelog-angular,conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits,template): group notes by their keyword (#1533)

Both presets rewrote the title of every note to `BREAKING CHANGES`, so a custom
parser `noteKeywords` entry — `SECURITY`, for example — ended up in the breaking
changes section and counted as a breaking change when recommending a version.

Notes are now grouped by their own keyword: breaking change spellings are merged
into a single group, any other keyword becomes a group of its own, and only
breaking changes affect the recommended bump. The conventionalcommits preset gets
`formatNoteTitle` and `formatNoteIcon` to rename groups and to put an icon in
front of them.

Fixes #815.

feat(conventional-changelog-angular,conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits,template): format references in breaking change notes (#1529)

Issue references were formatted in commit subjects only, so `issuePrefixes`
and `formatIssueUrl` had no effect on breaking change notes.

Both presets now share `createReferencesFormatter` from the template package
and apply it to notes and subjects. It keeps already formatted Markdown as is:
links, bare urls, fenced code blocks and single-line code spans.

This changes existing output: notes with the default `#` prefix are linked now,
and references inside code spans, links and urls in subjects are no longer
replaced.

Fixes #631.
